newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Hogar started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Hogar started as buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said Tuesday it had begun coverage of recently listed home builder Consorcio Hogar with a buy recommendation.
Analysts Sebastien Chatel and Paul Rodriguez wrote in a report that the company's volume growth should be strong over the next three years.
They cited a strong local home-building sector.
"Hogar's valuation is attractive in absolute terms and in relation to its peers," the analysts wrote.
They said gross margins should fall to 35.9 percent in 1997 and recover some in the next two years.
Estimated earnings per share growth is six percent for 1997 and 30 percent for 1998, they said.
The brokerage set a price target of 17.10 pesos on the stock.
The shares were trading at 11.42 pesos late Tuesday, up two centavos on the day.
